notes.title: Maiden Cops Patch Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660659/77df7bef26ba873e94ccbd536f35172c871ee84a.png[/img]

We’re bringing a new Maiden Cops update full of gameplay improvements, new features, and bug fixes! We deeply appreciate the support and feedback from everyone who helped make this possible. Check out the changes in this update below:

[h2]List of Improvements:[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]New action mappings[/b] – You can now configure buttons for the actions: Block, Release Grabbing Opponent, Collect Item, and Throw Weapon, providing more control for players.
[*] [b]Camera bug fix[/b] – Resolved the issue where the camera would get stuck when destroying rolling barrels off-screen.
[*] [b]Medal preview[/b] – You will now see the required value to achieve each medal on the payment screens at the end of each stage.
[*] [b]Parry system in the tutorial[/b] – The parry system is now part of the tutorial, helping new players get familiar with the mechanic.
[*] [b]Motorcycle stage shortened[/b] – The motorcycle stage has been shortened to keep the gameplay fast and dynamic.
[*] [b]More life items in stages[/b] – There are now more collectable life items throughout the stages, with special attention to the motorcycle stage.
[*] [b]Full health at the start of each stage[/b] – The protagonists now start each stage with full health.
[*] [b]Camera bug fix with throwing enemies[/b] – Resolved the issue where the camera would freeze when defeating certain knife-throwing enemies.
[*] [b]Adjustments to Maiden Justice achievements[/b] – Maiden Justice, Maiden Justice+, and Maiden Justice++ achievements now count all attacks (basic, with weapons, and special) for defeats.
[*] [b]Meiga’s Holster and weapons[/b] – Meiga can now use regular melee weapons, not just Heavy Weapons.
[/olist]

We want to thank everyone who has supported us so far. Your feedback is crucial in helping us improve Maiden Cops. Feel free to leave suggestions and bug reports in the Steam community hub.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2012670/discussions/0/4845399912176765279/]Join the Forum[/url]

notes.title: Update Patch: New Adjustments, Fixes, and Parry System!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660659/3a0362e6b136dbbb30b7c2fbda2d1e479eeec3fe.png[/img]

A new update for Maiden Cops has arrived, bringing a series of improvements, bug fixes, and a new defense mechanic. We want to thank everyone for your continued support and feedback that help us keep improving the game. Here’s the full list of changes:

Changelog:
[olist]
[*] [b]Adjustments to collectible items[/b] – We’ve added more health-restoring items in the stages to help during intense battles.
[*] [b]Improved defense system[/b] – The defense command is now detected in more animation states, ensuring a more responsive input.
[*] [b]Visible cheats during gameplay[/b] – Active cheats now appear in the bottom left corner of the GUI, making it easier to keep track of them during the game.
[*] [b]Max’s hitbox collision detection fix[/b] – Max’s attacks have been adjusted to ensure better accuracy.
[*] [b]Biker enemy Dulas helmets[/b] – No longer deal damage to the protagonists upon collision.
[*] [b]Grenades in Maiden Stadium[/b] – Fixed the behavior of grenades, they no longer chase the player.
[*] [b]Black screen bug fix[/b] – Resolved the issue that caused a black screen when returning from the tutorial via the Menu → Title Screen option.
[*] [b]Destructible objects (handrails)[/b] – Now disable their colliders when destroyed.
[*] [b]Weapon cheat fix[/b] – Fixed a bug where weapons would disappear after being thrown three times, even with the "weapons don’t lose charge" cheat active.
[*] [b]Grab time on bosses[/b] – Increased the time that protagonists can hold bosses. Bosses Vitória and Marine now have a chance to break free as part of their abilities.
[*] [b]Buffs for Nina and Priscila[/b] – Their attacks, grabs, and specials have been strengthened to make them even more powerful.
[*] [b]Thrown character bug fix[/b] – Protagonists can no longer be hit while in the "lying down" animation after being thrown.
[*] [b]Increased respawn time for enemies during boss fights[/b] – Enemies now take longer to respawn during boss encounters.
[/olist]

[h2]New Parry System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660659/9e93ab3d6b3fd85d095130a3714ab0a277cce5c8.gif[/img]

Now you can activate Parry to perform counter-attacks! By blocking at the right moment, near an enemy's strike, your character will counterattack, dealing damage and becoming invulnerable for a brief moment. Plus, you’ll gain energy for special attacks.

"[i]We are working on adding this new feature to the game's tutorial in a future update.[/i]"

We want to extend our thanks to everyone for the amazing support so far. Every piece of feedback is crucial in helping us improve Maiden Cops. Keep sharing your thoughts, suggestions, and reporting any issues in the Steam Community Hub. We’re committed to bringing more improvements and content soon!

Join the discussion here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2012670/discussions/0/4845399912176765279/]Steam Community Hub Link[/url]

Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660659/6e2499d014009afdaa05b000d3b6acf43fed7e27.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch Fixes: Gameplay Improvements and Adjustments
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660659/3a0362e6b136dbbb30b7c2fbda2d1e479eeec3fe.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes - Important Update[/h1]

Hello, players! We have a new update with several improvements and fixes for Maiden Cops. Check out the full list of changes below:

Patch Notes:

[olist]
[*] Blocking no longer consumes energy and now cancels 100% of incoming damage.
[*] Protagonists received buffs to attacks, specials, and grabs.
[*] When using continue in MaidenOver, the character selector now stays fixed on the last selected character the player use.
[*] Increased the energy gain rate for specials.
[*] [b]Fixed a bug[/b] where the character could get stuck when selecting the cheat that prevents being thrown.
[*] Enemy nerfs: reduced health, super armor removed from some common enemies, and Max's spinning attack has been nerfed.
[*] [b]Fixed a bug[/b] that would freeze the game when opening the Steam Overlay during cutscenes.
[*] Increased the number of hits possible on airborne enemies. [i]Remember that there's a cheat in the shop that removes this restriction[/i].
[*] The Fanservice button has been moved to the Right Stick on the joystick.
[*] The explosion damage in the first part of Maiden Central City has been removed.
[*] [b]Fixed the bug[/b] where it was impossible to hit knife-throwing enemies.
[/olist]

We would like to thank everyone for the amazing support, with a special shout-out to those who are helping by reporting bugs and providing suggestions.

[h3][u]Please note that we are still working on more fixes and updates to improve the game experience.[/u][/h3]

We have a dedicated thread for bug reports in the community hub. Stop by, leave your feedback, and help us make the game even better!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2012670/discussions/0/4845399912176765279/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2012670/discussions/0/4845399912176765279/[/url]

notes.title: 🚀 **Exciting Update for Maiden Cops!** 🚀
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=sEU3tD1c_WE;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to release the latest demo of Maiden Cops! Your patience and feedback since our last release have been essential in guiding our progress.

🌟 For everyone who has been following Maiden Cops' journey, we're confident you'll love what we've prepared. And, of course, keep sharing your thoughts with us.

Get ready to join forces with Priscila Salamander, Nina Usagi, and Meiga Holstaur. Together, they're more ready than ever to protect Maiden City from criminals!

**What's New?**

1. **Introduction to the Maiden Cops' Story:**
   - The emerging Security Crisis in Maiden City.
   - Surprise attack on the Maiden Cops prison complex.
  
2. 🎨 Refreshed pixel art for the scenes.
3. Brand-new keyarts for our protagonists.
4. Enhanced pixel art detailing with outlines, further highlighting both playable and non-playable characters.
5. New options such as selecting difficulty, disabling the automatic "grab" of enemies, and skipping cutscenes.
6. **Combat System Enhancements:**
   - Combos of special and regular moves.
   - Regulation of aerial attacks.
   - Limitation on how many times opponents can bounce off walls and scene edges.

7. Debut of the new enemy "Lenora, the Stone Golem".
8. Optimized movement speed for all playable and non-playable characters.
9. Enemies now come in tighter waves, making the game faster and more dynamic.
10. New collectibles and destructibles scattered throughout the scenes.
11. Added obstacles, like sewers and hydrants, to enrich the gameplay.

**Found a bug or have a brilliant idea?** 🐞🧠

notes.title: Maiden Cops Devlog #01 (Demo Update)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=54ol0dXXvcs;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone. Here we are with our first #MaidenCops Devlog. We've [b]updated the Demo[/b], and we invite you to play again and give us new suggestions! We really appreciate your feedback.

[b]The main changes to the game:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Enemy Variations (each enemy has different colors)
[*] Indication of the enemy that will attack (blinking in white color)
[*] Enemies bounce off on the edges allowing you to combine your attacks.
[*] Dodge enemy attacks (double tap up or down)
[*] Counterattack when the enemies grab the Priscila (use your energy to this)
[*] Priscila's skills activate with one single button
[*] Added two more songs
[*] The Priscila's tails can rise the enemies on the floor
[/olist]

Thank you, everyone. Have more suggestions? Did you find any bugs? Please report to us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2012670/discussions/0/5595176692481941494/]the community hub[/url]. There are some special topics there.
Don't miss anything from Pippin Game! Follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/PippinGames]social media[/url] and here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/pippingames]Steam[/url]!
